task.title: Setting up a self-managed deployment of Clair for a disconnected OpenShift Container Platform cluster
task.shortdesc: To install the clairctl command-line utility for a self-managed Clair deployment on OpenShift Container Platform, you can copy the binary from a Clair container with Podman and make it executable.
